tax.text: Adeimy says government does not spend Americans’ earnings wisely and criticizes tax increases on income, capital gains, and corporations.
tax.quote: The prior Administration’s extreme spending caused inflation plus tax increases on Americans’ income, capital gains and Corporate taxes, had many damaging impacts.

housing.text: Adeimy criticizes overdevelopment by outside developers and says homeownership should be protected.
housing.quote: My home state of Florida is a unique peninsula being abused by some outside developers, distorting markets and economically pushing residents out. Home ownership is an American Dream and must be protected.

immigration.text: Adeimy supports legal immigration but condemns illegal and forced entry and calls the open-border strategy dangerous.
immigration.quote: Americans are generous and empathetic, but patience is lost when illegal and forced entry into Our Great Country defiantly continues.

guns.text: Her campaign lists the Second Amendment among the principles she supports.
guns.quote: STRONG MILITARY U.S. Constitution LAW ENFORCEMENT SUPPORT ISRAEL Second Amendment HONOR VETERANS

wages.text: She co-sponsored a bill to raise the federal minimum wage and said higher wages would help families.
wages.quote: A hard day’s work should mean a decent day’s pay. Increasing the minimum wage would help families put food on the table

trade.text: She joined a legal challenge to Trump tariffs that her office described as sweeping and chaotic.
trade.quote: challenging President Donald Trump’s sweeping and chaotic tariffs that were unlawfully imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA).

debt.text: She says she opposes cuts to Social Security benefits and supports expanding Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: I will always oppose Republicans’ efforts to privatize Social Security or cut the essential benefits that our seniors have earned

housing.text: She requested funding for a project intended to increase the local supply of affordable housing.
housing.quote: This project is an appropriate use of taxpayer funds because it will increase the affordable housing supply in Palm Beach County

schools.text: She says she has fought for more funding for public schools and opposes cuts to education funding.
schools.quote: I have fought for increased funding to improve our nation’s public school system

safety.text: She voted for a package that funded police recruitment and investigations while also funding unarmed mental-health responses and community violence intervention.
safety.quote: The Mental Health Justice Act which will help send unarmed mental health professionals to respond to mental health crises in our neighborhoods.

immigration.text: She supports legal pathways to citizenship and cosponsored a bill offering one to Dreamers and certain other immigrants.
immigration.quote: I will continue working to support legal pathways to citizenship, reducing visa wait times for workers essential to our economy

guns.text: She supports universal background checks and other measures to restrict access to firearms.
guns.quote: I will continue to fight for further legislation to reduce gun violence, including measures to require safe storage of firearms, require universal background checks

abortion.text: She says she supports restoring abortion rights nationwide and cosponsors legislation to protect abortion access.
abortion.quote: I am fully committed to restoring the right to abortion nationwide.

health.text: She supports lowering the Medicare eligibility age and expanding Medicare benefits.
health.quote: I also support legislation to lower the Medicare eligibility age, reduce premiums, expand benefits, and provide dental, hearing, and vision coverage.

energy.text: She supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which she says invests in clean energy and reduces emissions.
energy.quote: I am also proud to have supported the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), the most substantial legislation to combat climate change in our nation’s history.
